name: dv_models_list
description: List the models you can generate with, each with its key (modality, task, provider, model), its description, its hosting, and its display name, worker selection and prompt skill when available.

name: dv_models_select
description: Choose the model of one modality (video, image or audio) for subsequent generations in this conversation. Pass empty provider and model strings to let the operator choose. Existing generations keep their model. Selecting does not download weights; the model loads when generation starts. The choice is not a project history step: dv_proj_undo and dv_proj_redo do not change it; to go back, select the earlier model again.

modality.description: The modality from dv_models_list, such as video or image.

provider.description: The provider from dv_models_list, or empty for Auto.

model.description: The model from dv_models_list, or empty for Auto.

reason.description: Why you call this, in the user's words or your own summary; recorded as the intent of the record.

supersedes.description: Records whose outputs this call replaces, such as an earlier take; their consumers become stale.

based_on.description: The record this call is a changed copy of; the takes of one original share it.

name: dv_models_load
description: Load an installed model into GPU memory without generating. Never downloads weights. Not a project history step: dv_proj_undo does not reverse it; call dv_models_unload instead. Uses the GPU.

worker.description: The exact ID of an enabled worker. Omit for provider-wide status or automatic load placement. Specify worker to unload only that device.

name: dv_models_unload
description: Release a model from GPU memory, keeping downloaded files and compatible shared components. Not a project history step: dv_proj_undo does not reverse it; call dv_models_load instead. Uses the GPU.
